eSignLaw.name: eIDAS Regulation and the Dutch Civil Code

levelNote: An electronic signature has the same effect as a handwritten one if the method is sufficiently reliable for the purpose and the circumstances.

formRequirements.note: A will must be made before a notary.
Property transfers need a notarial deed.

notices: Electronic signature law that applies: eIDAS Regulation and the Dutch Civil Code. An electronic signature has the same effect as a handwritten one if the method is sufficiently reliable for the purpose and the circumstances.
You must be at least 18 years old to sign this agreement.
If you are unsure whether this applies to you, ask for a paper alternative before signing.
limitationNote: Performance of obligations: five years from knowledge (art. 3:307 BW); an outer cap of twenty years applies.
